links.outcome: Share of GPT answers based on script information versus fictitious information
links.effect: Script-covered questions (n=502): 94.4% (n=471) answers based on explicit script information. Questions not covered (n=195): 56.4% (n=110) of answers used fictitious information.
links.quote: When questions were explicitly covered by the script (n=502, 60.3%), the GPT-provided answers were mostly based on explicit script information (n=471, 94.4%).

unlisted_practices: Using an LLM-powered chatbot with an illness script prompt as a simulated patient for medical student history-taking practice

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of a GPT-3.5-powered simulated patient for medical students practicing history taking, assessing script alignment, plausibility, and usability.
